Its heat release in the thermal decomposition tests was 485.7 J g^−1 for 50% Mn[2], compared with 901.4 J g^−1 for 10% Mn[3] for the 10% Mn[4] sample. The heat-flow legend in Fig. 4[5] gives the same values for these compositions. The numbers show that the higher-Mn sample released less heat.
